hero.lead: Pay your Sunflower invoice online through PayPal.

image.alt: Families gathered at a Sunflower Creative Arts event

sections.heading: How to pay your Sunflower invoice online

items.title: Open the PayPal payment page
items.html: Click the “Make a Payment” button (below) to go to the PayPal payment page.

items.title: Enter your invoice total
items.html: On the PayPal page, enter the total listed on your billing invoice in the “Item price” field.

items.title: Complete the transaction
items.html: Log in to your PayPal account or choose to pay by credit card to complete the transaction.
